generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Bidders shall ensure upload of relevant document certifying his/her status as Scheduled Caste/ Scheduled Tribe/other reserved category as prescribed in the tender document.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
General conditions mentioned in NIT Sl.No.(1) to (18).

technicalCriterionList.description: To qualify for award of this contract, each bidder in his/their name should have Satisfactorily completed as a prime contractor to an extent of Rs.10.55 lakh in at least one similar nature of work in any one of the last 5 years, i.e. 2021-22 to 2025-26 in any of the Government / Public undertaking. Order copies/ certificates issued from the cadre not less than the rank of Executive Engineer should be scanned and uploaded
The bidder should have valid PWD registration until the date of completion of work, if the work is awarded
The Bidder should submit the ESI registration certificate issued from the competent authority
The Bidder should submit the EPF registration certificate issued from the competent authority.

To qualify for award of this contract, each bidder in his/their name should have achieved an average annual financial turnover of Rs.21.10 lakh, in at least two financial years in the last 5 years, i.e. 2021-22 to 2025-26. Audited financial statement for the said five years duly signed by the Charted Accountant (with UDIN) should be uploaded.
